results.title: FRB: Informed and Strategic Order Flow in the Bond Markets
results.snippet: Even in the absence of the information effects of our model, inventory considerations (first formalized by Garman, 1976) may explain, either in full or in part, any significant correlation between price changes and order flow. Yield changes may in fact react to net order flow imbalances, to compensate market participants for providing liquidity, even when the order flow has no information content.
